# James Guevara Gamboa

> Frontend & Full Stack Developer based in Heredia, Costa Rica, open to remote work. Builds web applications, e-commerce platforms, corporate websites and headless CMS solutions with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Strapi, Shopify and WordPress.

James Guevara Gamboa is a freelance Full Stack Developer (since August 2024) who delivers production websites and web apps for real estate, commercial and corporate clients, with a focus on performance, accessibility, SEO and maintainability. Previous roles: Frontend & WordPress Developer at TechPro Solutions (2024) and Frontend Developer at ContraLuz (2023, remote). Education: FWD Costa Rica (Full Stack Web Developer, Backend Software Developer), CETAV (Web Design and Development Technician) and INA. Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2).

## Core stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL
- CMS and e-commerce: Strapi (headless), Shopify, WordPress, Drupal
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL
